name: cavemio-select
title: Select
description: Choose from an expanding pill with a gliding highlight, keyboard navigation, and a morphing label.

cavemio.usage:
import { Select } from "@/components/select";

<Select label="Plan" options={[{ value: "personal", label: "Personal" }, { value: "team", label: "Team" }]} defaultValue="personal" />
cavemio.accessibility: Labeled listbox with arrow keys, Home/End, typeahead, Enter/Space selection, Escape dismissal, focus restoration, and live reduced-motion support.
cavemio.previewNote: Try choosing a plan, typing to find a language, and scrolling the long list.

props.name: options
props.description: Choices with unique value, label, and optional description.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection; use onValueChange to update it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a different option is selected.

props.name: hint / error
props.description: Supporting text or validation feedback linked to the control.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Visually hides the label while retaining its accessible name.

props.name: block
props.description: Fill available width; defaults to true. Compact pills morph their label.

props.name: size
props.description: Compact toolbar or regular field height.

props.name: align / width
props.description: Popup alignment and preferred width, constrained to viewport.

props.name: display / renderValue
props.description: Customize selected text or render an icon/value.
